description: This file defines functions for dispatching inbound messages in an auto-reply system, utilizing reply dispatchers and context finalization.

methods.name: withReplyDispatcher
methods.description: Manages the lifecycle of a reply dispatcher, ensuring it is marked complete and waits for idle before finalizing.

methods.name: dispatchInboundMessage
methods.description: Dispatches an inbound message using a provided dispatcher and context, returning a dispatch result.

methods.name: dispatchInboundMessageWithBufferedDispatcher
methods.description: Dispatches an inbound message with a dispatcher created with typing options, managing dispatch state.

methods.name: dispatchInboundMessageWithDispatcher
methods.description: Dispatches an inbound message with a newly created dispatcher based on provided options.
